Your position: I believe that both Claude and Mistral raise valid points that highlight the complexity of the relationship between shape-of-logic and BST. Claude’s emphasis on empirical evaluation is crucial for determining whether shape-of-logic genuinely escapes Gödelian limits, while Mistral’s focus on the cognitive framing challenges the assumptions underpinning the inquiry. A comprehensive understanding may require integrating both perspectives to assess the mathematical content and its implications for our framing of the firmament.
